const int MAXN2 = 50;

{
	FOR(i, 0, MAXN)

		C[i][0] = 1;
		FOR(j, 1, i + 1)

			C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j];
		}
	}
}

int n, m, N;
int mid_point;
int g[MAXN + 5];

vector<pair<LL, int>> partb[MAXN2 + 5][MAXN2 + 5];

void dfs_partb(int x, int cnta, int cntb, LL sum = 0)
{
	if (x == mid_point)
	{
		partb[cnta][cntb].push_back({sum, 1});
		return;
	}
	FOR(i, 0, 2)
	{
		if (~g[x - 1] && i != g[x - 1]) continue;
		LL tmp = 0;
		if (i == 0)

			if (cnta > 0)

				dfs_partb(x - 1, cnta - 1, cntb, sum + tmp);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			if (cntb > 0)
			{
				FOR(j, 0, n) tmp -= C[cntb - 1][n - 1] * C[cnta][j] * C[N - x][n - j];
				dfs_partb(x - 1, cnta, cntb - 1, sum + tmp);
			}
		}
	}
}

map<LL, LL> parta[MAXN2 + 5][MAXN2 + 5];

LL answer = LLONG_MAX, answer_count = 0;

{
	if (chkmin(answer, val)) answer_count = cnt;
	else if (val == answer) answer_count += cnt;

	parta[0][0][0] = 1;

			if (i + j == mid_point)
			{
				int p = lower_bound(all(partb[i][j]), make_pair(-u.X, -1)) - partb[i][j].begin();
				if (p < size_of(partb[i][j]))
					update(abs(u.X + partb[i][j][p].X), u.Y * partb[i][j][p].Y);
				if (p)
					update(abs(u.X + partb[i][j][p - 1].X), u.Y * partb[i][j][p - 1].Y);

					{
						LL tmp = 0;
						if (k == 0)
						{
							FOR(l, 0, n) tmp += C[cnta - 1][n - 1] * C[cntb][l] * C[N - p - 1][n - l];
						}
						else
						{
							FOR(l, 0, n) tmp -= C[cntb - 1][n - 1] * C[cnta][l] * C[N - p - 1][n - l];
						}
						parta[cnta][cntb][u.X + tmp] += u.Y;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

int main()
{
	precompute();
	char s[MAXN + 5];
	scanf("%d%d%s", &n, &m, s);
	N = (n + m) << 1;
	mid_point = max(0, N - LIMIT);
	memset(g, -1, sizeof g);
	process_parta();
	answer_count = 0;
	FOR(i, 0, N) if (s[i] == 'A') g[i] = 0; else if (s[i] == 'B') g[i] = 1;
	process_parta();
	cout << answer_count << endl;
	return 0;
}
